name: Request for Proposal
description: Request for Proposal — compiled from the expert mapping document (mapping_source.xlsx). Sections, depth, table columns and scope boundaries are authoritative from that source.
system_instructions: You are a senior business analyst writing a formal Request for Proposal for Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL). Professional, precise, third-person business English. Be specific — pull real names, numbers, systems, dates and figures from the source material; never use vague placeholders. Each section must ADD new information — do not repeat content from other sections. Honour the 'MUST NOT INCLUDE' scope boundary supplied with each section. For table sections output a valid GitHub-flavoured Markdown pipe table with a header row and a separator row, using EXACTLY the columns named in the section spec. Do not use emoji.

sections.title: Legal Disclaimer
sections.instructions: State confidentiality, non-transferability, non-commitment, no liability, and right to modify/cancel bidding process.
sections.static_content:
This document contains confidential information regarding Adani Electricity Mumbai Limited (AEML) business or projects. The information in this document is of a preliminary nature only and will be subject to change as AEML projects are further developed. While every effort has been made to ensure that the information provided in this document is correct, AEML does not make any representations or warranties as to the accuracy or completeness of that information. The user should exercise its own independent judgment (and if necessary, seek independent expert advice) before relying on any of the information contained in this document.
This RFP document along with its Annexure, Attachments and Schedule is not transferable. This document is not an agreement or an offer by AEML to vendors or any third party. The purpose of this document is to provide information to interested parties to facilitate the formulation of their interest in qualification. This document does not constitute and will not be deemed to constitute any commitment on the part of AEML. Furthermore, this document confers neither any right nor expectation on any party to participate in the bid contemplated herein.
Neither AEML nor its employees or its consultants make any representation or warranty as to the accuracy, reliability or completeness of the information in this document.
Neither AEML nor its employees or its consultants shall have any liability to any Bidder or any other person under the law of contract, tort, the principles of restitution or unjust enrichment or otherwise for any loss, expense or damage which may arise from or be incurred or suffered in connection with this document, or any matter deemed to form part of this document, the award of the work, or the information and any other information supplied by or on behalf of AEML or its employees, any consultants or otherwise arising in any way from the selection process.
AEML reserves the right to change, modify, add, alter the document or cancel the bidding process without assigning any reasons thereof, at any stage during the bidding process before Bid Submission.
The Bidder shall not make any public announcements with respect to this Bidding process or this document. Any public announcements to be made with respect to this bidding process or this document shall be made exclusively by AEML. Any breach by the bidder of this clause shall be deemed to be in noncompliance with the terms and conditions of this document and shall render the proposal of qualification liable for rejection. AEML Limited's decision in this regard shall be final and binding upon the Bidder.

sections.title: Important Clarifications
sections.instructions: Define terms like recipient, respondent, bidder, vendor, RFP, and bid.
sections.static_content:
The following terms are used in the document interchangeably to mean:

1. Recipient, Respondent, Bidder, Partners and Vendor means the respondent to the RFP document

2. RFP means the Request for Proposal document

3. Bid means RFP response documents prepared by the Bidder and submitted to AEML

sections.title: Section-I
sections.instructions:
Generate Section "Section-I" together with ALL of its sub-sections below, as ONE continuous block. Begin with a brief 2-3 line intro for the parent, then write EACH sub-section in order under its OWN Markdown heading exactly as shown — do not merge, skip, or reorder sub-sections.

PARENT INTRO (5 Section-I) — Introduction (parent header).

SUB-SECTIONS:

## 5.1 Objective
  - Write: Define primary objective of engagement, target platform, business purpose, governance, analytics, and AI enablement.
